summary: Admit explicitly declared production user services on internal routes

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Replication authority and other route guards are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Linux internal routes can admit configured internal_services unit/exe pairs despite an unreadable same-user systemd manager environment. Undeclared services and other unreadable ancestors receive no exemption.

downtime.detail: No downtime beyond the normal daemon restart.

manual.detail: The host configuration must explicitly declare each authorized unit and its actual absolute executable path. Empty declarations grant no exemption. Restarting a declared unit with its real executable is an accepted same-user launch path.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
